name: Leona Winters
source:
An English teacher at school who is also [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url]'s neighbor. She's been friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c174092]Sandra[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c174117]Yuuna[/url] for a long time. She lives alone, and has been trying to change that fact without much success.
